```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(ExperimentHub)
library(CLAMPData)
eh <- ExperimentHub()
```

# Quick start

List resources for this package:

```{r list}
ExperimentHub::listResources(eh, package = "CLAMPData")
```

```{r accessors}
p_counts <- GSE164416_DP_htseq_counts_txt_gz()
p_h5     <- human_gene_v2_5_alz_h5()
p_meta   <- islets_metadata_csv()
c(p_counts, p_h5, p_meta)
```

Read the files with your preferred I/O:

```{r read}
# counts
readLines(gzfile(p_counts), n = 5)

# HDF5
if (requireNamespace("rhdf5", quietly = TRUE)) rhdf5::h5ls(p_h5)

# metadata CSV
head(read.csv(p_meta, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
```

# Session info

```{r session}
sessionInfo()
```
